KM_T_01.name: Immediately effective kamma
KM_T_01.description: Kamma that produces its result in the same life; if it cannot mature, it becomes defunct.
KM_T_01.doctrinalNote: Kamma that produces its result in the same life; if it cannot mature, it becomes defunct.

KM_T_02.name: Subsequently effective kamma
KM_T_02.description: Kamma that produces its result in the immediately following life.
KM_T_02.doctrinalNote: Kamma that produces its result in the immediately following life.

KM_T_03.name: Indefinitely effective kamma
KM_T_03.description: Kamma capable of producing results from the third life onward until final liberation.
KM_T_03.doctrinalNote: Kamma capable of producing results from the third life onward until final liberation.

KM_T_04.name: Defunct kamma
KM_T_04.description: Kamma whose opportunity to produce a result has passed.
KM_T_04.doctrinalNote: Kamma whose opportunity to produce a result has passed.

KM_P_01.name: Reproductive kamma
KM_P_01.description: Kamma that generates rebirth and the resultant aggregates of a new life.
KM_P_01.doctrinalNote: Kamma that generates rebirth and the resultant aggregates of a new life.

KM_P_02.name: Supportive kamma
KM_P_02.description: Kamma that supports and sustains the result of another kamma.
KM_P_02.doctrinalNote: Kamma that supports and sustains the result of another kamma.

KM_P_03.name: Obstructive kamma
KM_P_03.description: Kamma that obstructs or weakens the result of another kamma.
KM_P_03.doctrinalNote: Kamma that obstructs or weakens the result of another kamma.

KM_P_04.name: Destructive kamma
KM_P_04.description: Kamma that cuts off the result of another kamma and replaces it with its own result.
KM_P_04.doctrinalNote: Kamma that cuts off the result of another kamma and replaces it with its own result.

KM_U_01.name: Weighty kamma
KM_U_01.description: A very powerful wholesome or unwholesome kamma that takes priority in producing rebirth.
KM_U_01.doctrinalNote: A very powerful wholesome or unwholesome kamma that takes priority in producing rebirth.

KM_U_02.name: Death-proximate kamma
KM_U_02.description: Kamma remembered or performed close to death, influencing the next rebirth.
KM_U_02.doctrinalNote: Kamma remembered or performed close to death, influencing the next rebirth.

KM_U_03.name: Habitual kamma
KM_U_03.description: Kamma repeatedly performed until it becomes a strong habit.
KM_U_03.doctrinalNote: Kamma repeatedly performed until it becomes a strong habit.

KM_U_04.name: Cumulative kamma
KM_U_04.description: Accumulated kamma that produces a result when no stronger kamma takes priority.
KM_U_04.doctrinalNote: Accumulated kamma that produces a result when no stronger kamma takes priority.
